panels.title: Goal work — timeline, effort and completion
panels.description: Use the Grafana time picker and the panel's project/task filters. Summary effort counts raw spans once. Parent rows include descendants when requested. Lifecycle dates cover the task lifetime; recorded effort/status durations follow the chosen range. Unknown dates and interrupted observation remain explicit.
